name: --color-bg
description: Dark page graphite. Chalk text on this is 16.33:1.

name: --color-surface
description: Dark cards and the desktop logger pane. Chalk 15.14:1, accent text 5.44:1, line 4.14:1.

name: --color-raised
description: Dark fields, current set row, selected tab fill. Chalk 13.34:1, accent text 4.80:1, line 3.65:1.

name: --color-line
description: Control and card edges on dark. 4.46:1 on bg, 4.14:1 on surface, 3.65:1 on raised. Never use a quieter rule for controls.

name: --color-ink
description: Chalk. Primary text and timer numerals on dark. 16.33:1 on bg.

name: --color-ink-2
description: Muted text on dark. 8.79:1 on bg, 8.15:1 on surface, 7.18:1 on raised.

name: --color-accent
description: Plate-rust fill for Start, Finish, Log set, and the completed tick only. Chalk on fill is 4.75:1. Do not use this as text on dark (3.19:1 on surface).

name: --color-accent-text
description: Lighter rust for Next numbers and selected effort on dark. 5.87:1 on bg, 5.44:1 on surface, 4.80:1 on raised.

name: --color-on-accent
description: Chalk on accent fill, 4.75:1.

name: --color-bg-light
description: Light page, chalk paper. Ink 15.44:1, accent text 4.75:1, line 4.60:1.

name: --color-surface-light
description: Light cards. Ink 17.17:1, accent 5.28:1, line 5.12:1.

name: --color-raised-light
description: Light fields. Ink 14.12:1, muted 5.50:1, line 4.21:1. Do not put accent text here (4.34:1).

name: --color-line-light
description: Control and card edges on light. 4.60:1 on bg, 5.12:1 on surface, 4.21:1 on raised.

name: --color-ink-light
description: Primary text on light. 15.44:1 on bg.

name: --color-ink-2-light
description: Muted text on light. 6.01:1 on bg, 6.69:1 on surface.

name: --color-accent-text-light
description: Accent text on light uses the fill colour. 4.75:1 on bg, 5.28:1 on surface. Not for raised.

name: --font-display
description: Weight 600, tabular figures. Titles, exercise names, set numbers, Next targets, rest timer.

name: --font-sans
description: Weight 400 body, 600 labels and primary buttons. Minimum 13px. Self-host in production.

name: --font-size-min
description: Smallest allowed text (labels, chips, tab labels, captions).

name: --font-size-body
description: Body and button labels.

name: --font-size-title
description: Card titles and compact Next numbers.

name: --font-size-display
description: App wordmark and desktop session title.

name: --font-size-timer
description: Rest timer numerals, Barlow Condensed 600 tabular.

name: --radius
description: Cards, buttons, tabs, set rows.

name: --target
description: Minimum gym-sized control. Primary is 56–64px.
